snippet.title: Rapid Puppet gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Rapid Puppet is a wild mix of various genres that forms a unique and fast-paced gameplay experience. Roguelike action in the ever-changing worlds is designed to test your stamina and reaction speed. A set of upgradable skills and weapons to become an unstoppable Sci-Fi knight! Stream your run to show us how far you got and how hard you tried, so we can see if it even ever mattered. A passion project  forged through years of development. Energetic soundtrack, speed, freedom and struggle! Show us what you got and don't stop!
Please support Rapid Puppet on steam by adding it to your wishlist and subscribe for future updates!
store.steampowered.com/app/4002540/Rapid_Puppet
